3. This is an application under Section 438, Cr.P.C. filed by the Petitioner for anticipatory bail,
involving offence punishable under Sections 420/406/294/506/323/34 of the Indian Penal Code and read with Sections 63, 65 Copyright Act, 1957 (Amendment, 2012).
4.

Considering the seriousness of the allegation, gravity of the offence and the facts of the case,
although I am not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the Petitioner, however it is observed that, in the event the Petitioner surrenders and moves for bail before the learned Civil Judge (J.D.)-cum-J.M.F.C., Jatani in 1CC Case No.49 of 2023 arising out of Info Valley P.S. Case No.208 of 2023 within a period of four weeks from today, he shall be released on bail on such terms // 2 //
and conditions as the learned Magistrate may deem just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case, but subject to verification of criminal antecedent.

opennyai_summary.decision:
3. This is an application under Section 438, Cr.P.C. filed by the Petitioner for anticipatory bail,
involving offence punishable under Sections 420/406/294/506/323/34 of the Indian Penal Code and read with Sections 63, 65 Copyright Act, 1957 (Amendment, 2012).
4.
Considering the seriousness of the allegation, gravity of the offence and the facts of the case,
although I am not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the Petitioner, however it is observed that, in the event the Petitioner surrenders and moves for bail before the learned Civil Judge (J.D.)-cum-J.M.F.C., Jatani in 1CC Case No.49 of 2023 arising out of Info Valley P.S. Case No.208 of 2023 within a period of four weeks from today, he shall be released on bail on such terms // 2 //
and conditions as the learned Magistrate may deem just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case, but subject to verification of criminal antecedent.
In the event, the Petitioner is having more than one criminal antecedents, then this order stands automatically revoked.
Further, the Petitioner be released on bail subject to condition that he shall not indulge in similar nature of offence and shall cooperate with the investigation and shall appear before the Police Station when required by I.O. for the purpose of investigation.
It is further directed that the bail granted to the Petitioner be subject to depositing a cash security of Rs.5,000/- (Rupees five thousand) of each before the learned Court in seisin over the matter,
which shall be kept in any Nationalized bank in interest bearing account initially for a period of one year which will be renewable from time to time till conclusion of trial and the same shall be abide by the final outcome of the trial of the case.
Violation of such conditions shall entail cancellation of the bail application.
5. The ABLAPL is disposed of accordingly.
6. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
